Al Manhal Oilfield Services Announces Major Expansion in UAE

Al Manhal Oilfield Services, a leading provider in the Oil & Gas Services & Equipment sector, unveiled plans today for a significant expansion of its operations in the United Arab Emirates. The initiative includes the construction of a new logistics and maintenance hub in Abu Dhabi, as well as investments in advanced drilling technologies.

The project, valued at an estimated AED 420 million, is expected to be completed by mid-2025 and will create over 250 new jobs in engineering, logistics, and technical support. Company officials say the expansion is in response to growing demand for oilfield services in the region as the UAE continues to invest in its energy sector.

“We are committed to supporting the UAE’s vision of sustainable energy development,” said Khalid Al-Suwaidi, Chief Executive Officer at Al Manhal Oilfield Services. “This expansion will strengthen our service capabilities and allow us to better serve our clients in both onshore and offshore projects.”

The announcement was welcomed by the Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce and Industry. “Al Manhal’s investment reflects confidence in our local economy and reinforces the UAE’s position as a regional hub for energy services,” said Aisha Al Nuaimi, Director of Industrial Development at the Chamber.

Industry analysts point to a steady recovery in the global oil market and ongoing infrastructure projects in the Gulf as key drivers behind the expansion. “We are seeing increased capital expenditure in oil and gas services across the region, with a particular emphasis on operational efficiency and safety,” commented Faisal Harb, an energy analyst based in Dubai.

The new facility will feature state-of-the-art workshops and training centers, supporting the development of local talent and the adoption of new technologies. Al Manhal Oilfield Services says it will prioritize Emirati employment and work closely with vocational institutes.
